raw_response:
This plot is small and not mine — I rent it, so I do not want to spend too much cash on it. Last year I put a little manure from my cattle and the sorghum grew well enough, so I will do the same this year. Fertilizer from the cooperative is expensive and one bag is too much for 0.12 hectares, and I do not have the cash for it anyway. I will use my own seed I saved from last harvest, like my neighbors do, and weed with my wife and children by hand.
